title: The last night of 2025
logline: The garage on the last night of the year: the lamp unlit, the boxes to thirty-five, the pup in the bed by the door, the window with a firework's white from the dock in it. One more year of pages; the page knows and the boxes don't.

panels.composition: The garage at night with an unlit lamp on the drafting table, a wall of numbered boxes ending at thirty-five, an old three-legged dog in a bed by the door, and a small window holding a firework's white flash.

characters.pose: in the bed by the door

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a garage studio at night with an unlit lamp on a drafting table, a wall of numbered cardboard boxes and an old three-legged dog in a bed by the door, a small window holding a firework's white flash, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run

art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
